description: Angular component for mobile app configuration dialog in Thingsboard UI, handling settings export and user preferences.

classes.name: MobileAppConfigurationDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring mobile app settings, exporting configuration, and managing user preferences.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog, optionally updating user preferences if 'notShowAgain' is true.

methods.name: downloadSettings
methods.description: Gathers app settings and exports them as a JSON file.

methods.name: createMarkDownSingleCommand
methods.description: Formats a command string into markdown code block.
